1259. 1. Juni, О. �?О. — Bischof Johann von Prag bestätigt die an das neue Cistercienserkloster zu Hohenfurt von dessen Stifter, Wok von Rosenberg, gemachten Schenkungen.

III. Johannes dei gratia Pragensis episcopus vniuersis presentes litteras inspecturis salutem in domino Jesu Christo. Pie postulatio uoluntatis effectu debet prosequenle compleri, ut et deuotionis sin- ceritas laudabiliter enitescat et utilitas postulata nires indubitanter assumat. Eapropter uniuersitati uestre huius scripti continencia volumus esse notum, quod nobilis vir Wocco de Rosmberk, marsalcus regni Boemie, compater noster karissimus, cenobio quod in honore et memoria sanete Marie gloriose uirginis de nouo fundari fecit, in bonis suis ultra Rosmberk sub nemore Cisterciensis ordinis nostre dyocesis, Hohenuurt uulgariter appellato, pro suorum peccatorum remedio, propriam et progenitorum suorum salutem operihus miseri- cordie procurare cupiens, predia ecclesias decimas de nostra conni 3 ucucia et subscriptos reditus rationis sue compos existons pietatis intuitu dedit liberalster et concessit; ac de hiis ut patronus legitimus et fundator dotauit cenobium supradictum coram nobis et suis multis commilitonibus et amicis de consensu Heduigis dilecte coniugis sue et principalium consanguineorum suorum, metas speciales ei et legi timos distinguendo terminos uoce propria in hunc modum: Nemus ex altera parte Wlytaue fluminis uersus occidentem attingens uiam illam que ducit Helfenberk, Hohenuurt cenobio quod de nouo fun- daui, faciat mctam unam; et in parte orientali alia meta transit riuum quendam qui uocatur minor Wlitauich, et ambit pratum Zbya- del, ut idem pratum cum aliis bonis concHisum ipso termino ad dic tum cenobium pertineat intrgraliter pleno iure. Item alia meta' in riuo Mokri nomine terminetur, qui terminus incipiens a flumine Wli- taua dirigitur ascendendo usque ;ui bortum riuuli ¡am predicti, et inde per montemHradisch in minorem Wlitauich reuertiturex directo, et ascendit in illo riuo usque ad altitudinem silue Buemiam et Baua- riam diuidentem. Item alia et ultima meta ex ista parte Wlitaue in cipiens ab ipsa Wlitaua ascendit per decursum cuiusdam ripe, que Psyn uocatur, usque ad montem quendam Strasedelnik nominatum et ab eo ascendit directe preterions metas et terminos uülarum que fuerant Suatomiri, usque ad metas domini W'itkonis de Crumlow. Predicto insuper cenobio piscaturas concessit et per bas metas di- stinxit, uidelicet quud mete piscationis iamdicte incipiant a riuo Mokri iu flumine Wlitaua et ascendant usque ad metas Witkonis predicti, llii autem sunt redditus et prediu de quibus mentio est facta superius, quos ipse Wocco in nostra presencia uoce sua expressit publice isto modo: Do, pater reuerende domine Johannes Pragensis episcope, de assensu uestro et iam dedi Hohenuurt cenobio de nouo fundato ecclesiam in Rosntal cum omnibus suis pertinencias et usu totali, et partem tertiam decimarum tam de hiis villis meis quibus utor, quam de illis quas in feudo contuli de parrochia ecclesie iam predicte, et de curia mea M ihn ich decimas integrales. Item do ecclesiam in Pre- dol cum omni fructu qui ab ea poterit prouenire, et de toto Predol decimas plenas, et de villis ad me et ecclesiam de Predol iamdictam spectantibus ac de curia mea Polen decimas integrales, et in Sla- uetych de septem araturis decimas totales et plenas que dicuntur integrales, frugum scilicet agnellorum porcellorum caseorum et aliorum cunctorum prouentuum. Item uillam Sedlech iuxta Predol, que etiam in Predol ad ecclesiam pertinebat. Item villam Gute- prunne superiorem, que est sita iuxta Strobnich, cum omni suo fructu. Item uilla Wintersdorph me procurante ad idem cenobium est donata. Item de villa mea Lutwinouich tercium manipulum deci marum, et de villa mea Plan etiam partem tertiam decimarum. De assensu insuper uestro, domine episcope, do uolo et ordino ac dis- pono incommutabiliter, ut omnes ville que in hereditate mea situm habent inter Wlitauam et ripam Wlitauich maiorem, et que ibidem inposterum locabuntur, ad forensem ecclesiam in Hohenuurt per- tineant et ab ipsius ecclesie plebano qui pro tempore fuerit, incole earum recipiant uniuersa ecclesiastica sacramenta, et ei parrochalia iura persoluant, et ab eo audiant divina offitia, et corpora defunc- torum sepeliantur in eiusdem ecclesie cimiterio sicut decet, et dent ¡psi plebano de omnibus agris quos excolunt et excolent in futurum, partem terciam decimarum. Item in terra Opauie villam unam nomine Kotchen de nouo fundatam et plantatam cum omni suo iure et pro- uentibus donau (sic) cenobio antedicto. Item de Sonberk duas partes decimarum, et de Stradenich tercium manipulum decimarum, et de curia nostra Malsich decimas integrales. Item in Sedlechrnt duas areas cum agris suis. Item villam Babich cum omni prouentu, qui ex ea poterit prouenire. Item villam Ponedraz apud Wesele dedi dicto cenobio pleno iure. Et bec omnia et singula sepedictus Wocco compater noster donauit nominato cenobio Hohenuurt libere quiete pleuarie et integre iure hereditario perpetuo possidenda, petens a nobis humiliter et deuote, ut hoc factum eius in omnibus et per omnia generaliter et singulariter dignaremur nostre confirmationis robore et litteris nostris facti seriem continentibus cum sigilli nostri apensione, ut conuenit, roborare. Nos uero piis uotis et salubribus desideriis fauore beniuolo concurrentes, donationem dotationem et ordinationem ipsius in premissis omnibus et singulis premissorum rite et rationabiliter ac sulubriter et legitime celebratam auctoritate qua fungimur, confirmamus et presentis scripti patrocinio commu- nimus, facientes ipsum honorabili dicti cenobii sigilli nostri caractere insignitum conuentui fauorabiliter assignari. Nulli ergo omnino ho- minum liceat hanc nostre confirmationis paginam infringere aut ei ansu temerario contraire. Si quis contrarium attemptare presump- serit cum Datan et Abyron et cum Juda traditore domini et cum hiis qui dixerunt domino deo: „Recede a nobis scientiam uiarum tuarum riolumus", recipiat porcionem. — Actum et datum anuo gratie M°C«C°lvinj. entries.english:
On 1 June 1259, Bishop Johannes of Prague confirms the gifts made by Wok von Rosenberg, founder of the new Cistercian monastery at Hohenfurt.

Johannes, by the grace of God Bishop of Prague, to all who inspect this letter: greetings in the Lord Jesus Christ. A pious request should be fulfilled in deed, so that the sincerity of devotion may shine commendably and the requested benefit may be securely obtained. Therefore, we wish the contents of this document to be known to all: the noble Wok von Rosenberg, marshal of the Bohemian realm and our dearest co-father, wishing to secure the salvation of his own soul and that of his forebears through works of mercy, generously gave and granted, for the remedy of his sins, the estates, churches, tithes, and revenues set out below, of his own free will and with full understanding, to the monastery he newly founded in honor and memory of the glorious Virgin Mary, on his lands beyond Rosenberg, beneath the forest called Hohenfurt, for the Cistercian Order in our diocese. As its lawful patron and founder, he endowed the monastery before us and many of his companions-in-arms and friends, with the consent of his beloved wife Hedwig and his principal kinsmen, marking out its rightful boundaries as follows. On the west, the forest beyond the Vltava reaches the road leading to Helfenberg and forms one boundary of the new monastery of Hohenfurt. On the east, another boundary crosses a stream called the Little Vltavice and surrounds the meadow Zbyadel, so that this meadow and the other enclosed lands belong wholly and in full right to the monastery. Another boundary follows the stream called Mokri, beginning at the Vltava and going upstream to the source of that stream, then over Mount Hradisch back to the Little Vltavice, and upstream to the ridge dividing Bohemia and Bavaria. The last boundary on this side of the Vltava begins at the Vltava, follows a bank called Psyn to Mount Strasedelnik, and runs directly past the boundaries of the villages formerly belonging to Svatomir as far as the lands of Lord Witko of Krumlov. Wok also granted the monastery fisheries bounded from the stream Mokri in the Vltava upstream to the lands of the aforesaid Witko. He publicly specified the properties and revenues as follows: “Reverend Father, Lord Bishop Johannes, with your consent I give, and have already given, to the newly founded monastery of Hohenfurt the church at Rosenthal with all its appurtenances and full use, and one third of the tithes from my own villages and those I have enfeoffed in the parish of that church, and the full tithes from my estate at Mühlnich. I also give the church at Predol with all its income, full tithes from all Predol and from the villages belonging to me and that church, and full tithes from my estate at Polen; at Slavětice, full tithes from seven ploughlands, namely of crops, lambs, piglets, cheeses, and all other produce. I also give the village of Sedlech near Predol, which belonged to the church at Predol; the upper village of Guteprunne near Strobnich with all its produce; and the village of Wintersdorf, which has been donated to this monastery through my efforts. From my village of Lutwinouich I give one third of the sheaf tithe, and from my village of Plan one third of the tithes. With your consent, Lord Bishop, I irrevocably give, will, and ordain that all villages situated on my hereditary land between the Vltava and the bank of the greater Vltavice, and those that may be settled there in future, belong to the monastery church at Hohenfurt. Their inhabitants shall receive all ecclesiastical sacraments from its parish priest, whoever he may be, pay him parish dues, hear divine offices from him, and bury their dead in that church’s cemetery as is proper; they shall give him a third of the tithes from all the fields they cultivate now or in future. In the land of Opava I give to the aforesaid monastery the newly founded village of Kotchen with all its rights and revenues; two thirds of the tithes from Sonberg; a third sheaf of the tithes from Stradenich; the full tithes from our estate at Malsich; two farmsteads with their fields at Sedlechrnt; the village of Babich with all its produce; and the village of Ponedraz near Wesele in full right. All these properties and each of them the aforesaid Wok, our co-father, has donated to the named monastery of Hohenfurt, to be held freely, peacefully, fully, and entirely in hereditary right forever.” He humbly and devoutly asked us to confirm this act generally and in every particular by our authority and letters setting out its terms, authenticated by our seal. We, favorably supporting these pious vows and wholesome wishes, confirm by our authority the donation, endowment, and disposition described above, lawfully and reasonably made, and secure them under the protection of this document. We cause this charter, marked with our honorable seal, to be delivered to the monastery’s convent. Let no one infringe this confirmation or rashly oppose it; whoever presumes to do so shall share the fate of Dathan and Abiram, Judas the betrayer of the Lord, and those who said to God, “Depart from us; we do not desire knowledge of your ways.” Enacted and given in the year of grace 1259, on the Kalends of June, indiction 15.

One seal hangs from green-red silk cords and is damaged; otherwise as described in II. References: Jongelin, Notes on Cistercian Abbots, book V, p. 10; Sommersberg, Scriptores I, 1, p. 927 no. 9; Millauer, p. 12; Proschko, p. 3.
